summary: Claim: G = ℤ₂ (the discrete group with two elements) is a non-trivial Polish group that is uniquely homogeneous, since |Homeo(ℤ₂)| = 2 and for any p, q ∈ ℤ₂ there is exactly one permutation/homeomorphism sending p to q; likewise, the trivial group with one element is also uniquely homogeneous (and Theorem 1.1 explicitly requires more than two elements for this reason).
